MISMATCH: the agenda gives 'Walnut Creek, CA' but NCRF's registry and website list Walnut, CA (Los Angeles County) and San Diego; no Walnut Creek office found. Likely an agenda typo but not confirmed

profile.summary: A nonprofit education organization that works to reduce the high school dropout rate and increase college and certificate enrollment among underserved students. It runs college expos, scholarship help, mentoring, academic support, and college and career planning.
